reviews.text: A million memories. A defining part of my life.

Dear István Street Clinic Management! Unfortunately, we were at the clinic today, an 11-year-old dog with serious skin, orthopedic and neurological diseases had bloody stools, a buttock… He was kept waiting for 3 hours, I would like to thank the receptionists, especially the blonde receptionist, for her immense kindness and outstanding intelligence, referring here, among other things, to the fact that in a clinic full of patients it is not appropriate to speak sarcastically, smiling and rolling your eyes about the owners waiting there and calling in. Of course, it reflects his human nature quite well that he can only mention what concerns his grievance, but does not go into how he treats the estranged owners who leave half a month's salary there. Having read several comments, I think that the management should consider the immediate dismissal of such a highly social and compassionate colleague as soon as possible.
Both in terms of empathy and attitude to work, it poisons the atmosphere of the university and absolutely ruins the prestige of the once famous university. It is a fact that there are quite serious specialties at the university, whether at professorial or other hierarchical levels, but it is important to know that it is highly recommended to eliminate toxic elements, since poison can be extremely destructive not only to the human and animal organism, but also to the social community of a renowned and famous university.
So as technology develops, so does medicine, I would recommend developing reception as well, since it is lagging behind in this so-called technological development.
In order for something to develop, you have to invest time, energy, or I could even say that it is also a matter of attitude. But unfortunately, there are people who, despite their efforts and will, cannot or do not want to jump over this not-so-high obstacle. Such elements must be removed from the already complex system as soon as possible. So, the very nice blonde receptionist would be better off being sent to an empathetic workplace with immediate effect, but personally, for example, I would suggest her to become a shepherd or shepherd, for which she certainly has all the qualities and empathy. So, thank you very much for your kindness today and I can only repeat my immense helpfulness. I welcome the RECEPTION, the clinic's most outstanding department, which makes professors lie. Regards; László Balogh, English bulldog owner

Dear Animal Clinic management, is the blonde receptionist still working there? Can someone please let me know when they will finally send her? Because it's about time she was sent away, since she is blind!!!!
They are professionals, they really understand animals.
It was nice

Although there were some nice doctors among the staff, the institution's communication and patient follow-up are disastrous. We spent more than 300,000 forints on various tests, yet we almost had to beg for the paid results to be sent by e-mail at all.
When we tried to reach them after receiving the fresh, serious results to find out the treatment plan and what to do, they didn't even pick up the phone and didn't return our calls. We had to face the serious diagnoses in complete uncertainty and on our own. They knew that my dog's condition was life-threatening and how serious the disease was, yet we didn't receive any meaningful help or guidance on how to proceed. My dog ​​eventually died in my hands.
I am deeply disappointed. A university-level clinic would be expected not to let go of the owner's hand after performing the extremely expensive diagnostic tests and to remain available when the animal's life depends on minutes. I don't wish this helplessness on anyone.
Very lovely and beautiful campus.
The park is not open for public.
I would like to highlight the professional knowledge of Dr. Ágnes Stelczer! Thank you!!! 🙏😊 …
They are very helpful in the study department.

A big thank you to all the staff who helped my cat Ivory recover. She had an extra large tumor in her chest, which Professor Tibor Németh successfully removed, despite the fact that it was a very risky operation. A big thank you to the staff of the internal medicine department, who helped a lot with her recovery after the operation.
Everything went as planned. The doctor and the assistants were very kind.

I recommend Dr. Dóra Csatári to everyone, she is very kind and knowledgeable.
And the assistants are also very good :)

A dirty team! My dog ​​was in 24-hour care for 10 days as a kidney patient. I visited him every day, I spoke to a different doctor every day!!! They were wondering what could be wrong with him!? I left about 1 million forints there, of course I would have paid more! Tracyke left it here. Oh, and they also billed for something that was no longer relevant. So, they are experimenting and taking money. Fuck them!
Very nice university!
I can only say the best about them, both from a human and medical perspective. Maximum helpfulness, professional medical and assistant team! 👏 …
A thorough, careful veterinary examination.
Everything went smoothly. My dog ​​received professional care.
A true animal-friendly, animal-loving people and environment, professionally trained doctors and assistants, an excellently equipped clinic (CT, ultrasound, X-ray) I can only recommend it!
A very prepared, dedicated and kind team of doctors! I can only recommend them!
I have only positive experiences.

I took our 3-month-old kitten to radiology, requesting a smooth appointment over the phone! The entire procedure, taking the scan, sending the results and evaluating it was extremely fast and everyone was very kind and professional! :)

I can't give it a starless rating. A dog suspected of having a stroke didn't show any symptoms, they laughed because the uncertain dog was in a carrier. The assistant is a tall woman, she called the doctor several times, they came back smiling with Dr. Babits Emma Léda, mainly to make me pay for the blood test fee, which she only took because I insisted. The dog is being treated on Lehel Road with a suspected stroke. If you don't mind sitting down, the dog will show symptoms in half an hour. The owner knows the dog and there were clear symptoms, although not at the time. The 1 star is because with this blood test we were able to move on to where they took it seriously.
Although I had to wait quite a long time, I am completely satisfied with Dr. Zsolt Szentgáli's expertise, the equipment of the office, and his professionalism! I absolutely recommend him!
It is a very beautiful building, the ornamental gardens and statues are particularly beautiful. The concierges are respectful and helpful.
For me, it is the second most beautiful building complex after the Dohány Street Synagogue. I love being inside the buildings on open days, at open lectures, in the garden which is fabulous....🐾 …
The persons who work here is very kind and professional.
Beautiful internal park, old buildings
There were very good programs during the Night of Museums.

1 star.

I paid 49,000 HUF for a dermatology consultation for my dog, who has been suffering from widespread skin lesions for over 1.5 months affecting her thighs, legs, back, chest, and all four paws. Before the appointment, I had already been using chlorhexidine products and Nizoral (ketoconazole) shampoo with only partial improvement, and I made this clear during the consultation.

No skin cytology, skin scrapings, fungal culture, or any other diagnostic tests were performed. The examination consisted mainly of looking at the skin and using a Wood's lamp. Despite explaining that I was already using these products, I was prescribed the same chlorhexidine treatment and Nizoral shampoo that I already had at home.

I understand that specialist expertise has value, but after paying 49,000 HUF, I expected a more thorough diagnostic approach or at least a clear explanation as to why no further tests were considered necessary. I left with the same treatment I had already been using and without answers as to why my dog's condition persists.

Very disappointing experience.
The doctors are kind and professional. There is not enough parking inside, I had to carry my dog ​​out on my lap after surgery.
I visited Dr. Dunai with my 8-year-old, Forl-stricken cat. My cat received professional care, the doctor is thorough and an extraordinary specialist. Thank you very much for your work.
Fantastic place wonderful doctors

We are deeply outraged by what we have experienced here. We took our puppy to the emergency room, who had recently undergone a major tumor operation, and today he has developed symptoms similar to an epileptic seizure. Of course we were very scared and stressed, but we communicated normally and respectfully throughout.

Despite this, we were told that our dog would not be cared for and sent away. We find this completely unacceptable for an animal that had recently undergone a major operation and was showing urgent symptoms.

The condescending and unsympathetic attitude we encountered was particularly outrageous. As owners, we desperately tried to get help for our sick dog, but we received neither substantive help nor adequate information.

We are disappointed, angry and devastated by what happened. One would expect much more from an institution that provides emergency care.

Based on our own experience, I cannot recommend this hospital and I hope that others do not have to go through a similar situation.
Our dog received exceptionally friendly and competent treatment. The waiting time from registration to being called was a mere 15 minutes.

I do not recommend it to anyone! The receptionist was not helpful at all! My daughter got a Pomeranian Spitz puppy. We brought her in because her stool was bloody. The lady at the reception said they only accept appointments. I asked her what if her stool was bloody and slimy? She said she would ask the doctor. She left the doctor's office but didn't even bother to answer me, she started dealing with the person who arrived. We waited a bit and then left.
It's a bit difficult to find your way around, but everyone is very nice!
I don't understand why you have my phone number if you're not going to answer the phone! Is there just one person there? What is he doing eating!?

We took our American bulldog for a progesterone test, where we ended up with Dr. Eszter Nagy. She greeted us with incredible professionalism, kindness and attention. It was the best decision possible to contact her, I can only recommend her!
We go there with our guinea pigs. We are very satisfied.
Considering the circumstances, it's great, calm and well-cared for. Very nice and dedicated doctors!
Expertise, with attention
Dear doctors, a detailed explanation of the patient's treatment. A medium-sized dog underwent surgery for a torn knee ligament...

Today, Sunday, April 12, 2026, is the presidential election in Hungary. I will not relinquish my presidential documents, including my Viking crown and all associated crowns, Magyar crowns, ownership documents, and even Viktor Orbán's ownership documents! I will neither relinquish nor relinquish my David Szalay imperial crowns and ownership documents!

EU Empress
President 1991-2000 GO GOTLAND
All the best & Happy Easter!
Hay Art Empress Linz/Ebelsberg/Urfahr Austria 1962-2026
The Department of Physical Education is good! 😊 …

I wouldn't write about the doctors working there now, because their work and expertise are fantastic. However, parking is not easy around the university. I would especially like to draw your attention to the fact that there is a parking time limit on the street, which protects the residents. If we don't take this into account, the wheel clamp will click.
I experienced his professional, courteous and helpful attitude. Even the doorman behaved like a gentleman! Thank you for the experience! Rudi

We went for an endoscopy with my 10-year-old cat, where we got an appointment very quickly. We went with difficulty breathing. The doctor, Borbála Mózes, is very professional, kind, patient and explained everything very clearly. She is kind, empathetic and loves animals. I am very grateful to her for what she has done for my cat so far. Thank you

I have mixed feelings about this place. I had a big help with my cat teeth. It was a lady, don't remember her name. But ultrasound is extremely expensive. 46 k for abdominal one, this is insane. So I'd recommend to be selective about the services here. There are a lot of private vets with better reviews and cheaper prices.

I am truly sorry that after 40 minutes of waiting and after making an appointment in advance (which is no longer possible by phone or extension, only by email again..), my pet/rodent was not able to be treated, even though the female Doctor was my last resort, because we went with a purulent-mucous tumor, my guinea pig suddenly became very sick, so I visited her as an expert in the exotics department.
Knocking is prohibited, because there is a poster on all the doors with “caps lock”, the receptionist did not tell me, and the female Doctor did not write in the email either, that even after our correspondence, I STILL HAD TO APPLY IN at another building, even though we had agreed on what time/minute I should come. The whole thing was a joke, outrageous, and when the female Doctor came out after 40 minutes, she said that she did not have time for it.
Very sad..
What did you swear to?
Thank you.
Good uni

I’m extremely grateful for the care we received this weekend! I brought my dog in, and the team treated us with endless patience and kindness. They answered all my questions thoroughly and provided helpful advice along with all the necessary information. It’s clear they’re not only experts but genuinely care about both the animals and their owners. I wholeheartedly recommend them!
One Sunday in the summer of 2025, our cat was rescued after a plastic thread got tangled in its intestines from a toy. Everyone was very nice and informed us about everything immediately.

I advise everyone against it! The receptionist "lady" is obnoxious and rude. Inexperienced residents were swarming the office. They shamelessly and unscrupulously quoted horrific prices. 100,000 HUF for a tartar removal????? Is this a joke????? These little anonymous beginners still have a lot to learn in practice. Not to mention that we waited at least two hours before we were allowed in. My little 3.5 kilo yorkie was very sick, so he needed urgent care. I will never, ever go here again!!!! What they do is unethical. They should be ashamed of themselves for asking for double or triple the prices. I could feel the money-hungry, greedy attitude of the little young resident. "How much of a down payment can you give me?" His behavior was disgusting. This was on Saturday, I paid them the 36,400 HUF yesterday, but I will not go anywhere near this place. Plus, they originally said 31200. They even cheated on that!!!
I was there as a visitor for a defense. It's not that attractive from the outside, but it looks nice from the inside.
beautiful environment
Thanks
We came to see Dr. Zsuzsanna Vízi, she is knowledgeable and attentive.
Professional care.

My vet sent me in. Koi fish has severe bloating, internal bacterial infection. They turned me away from the hospital. Even though it's a serious case that requires immediate action. There's no one there who can look at it... now I don't know if he's talking more about his professional training or the care of the animals.. anyway, I found a private practice where he got a diagnosis and medication in 10 minutes.. Anyway, the fish is better now....
Thorough, conscientious examination, accurate information, and recommendations.

The patient manager specifically has anger management issues. My appointment was at 8:00 AM. Of course, I arrived a few minutes early to check in. Without saying thank you, he started inarticulately telling me that there is patient management from 8:00 AM. I say I understand, but this can also be communicated nicely.
If someone is unable to communicate with people, I beg you. Don't work among people. There must be room next to the assembly line.

The most international veterinary campus with  a beautiful park next to the city center. The 140 years old school Renaissance buildings also represent the traditions. Have a look át the statues of people with impact on veterinary science.
They were very kind. We had to wait, unfortunately, and we went for an appointment, but thank God it wasn't long. There were no hidden costs. 5 stars for kindness and expertise. ❤️

The professionals are excellent but the waiting time is terrible. They called me in for 12 hours with my cat, and I was still sitting in the waiting room at 2:00. I drove 220 km with the animal just to get there. Once they give you an appointment, they try to keep it, it's okay - an hour, but 2-3 hours is outrageous!

Everyone should avoid the surgical department... I should definitely do that so that the unfortunate owner can be persuaded to undergo incredibly expensive and unjustified surgeries even when there is clearly no chance... and this is organized and managed by the head of the department, there is no mention of animal protection here... the goal is to get paid in any case... my dog ​​with an incurable tumor that was visible on the CT scan was operated on by another doctor for a mere 600 thousand forints in half an hour... and two weeks later he had to be put to sleep, unfortunately, because of a tumor that was clearly visible to the naked eye, but both CT and humans produce such results, believe me... judging the dog as a possibility... but they decide together in order for it to happen... what is going on there is nothing but massive animal cruelty... they didn't feed my unfortunate 11-year-old dog that was locked up for 3 days for 60 thousand forints... everyone is a real doctor avoid surgery, you German wine brigade...who wants the best for their dog...

Our guinea pig was treated very quickly (he had kidney stone surgery).
They were kind and professionally prepared.
Dr. Dóra Csatári was our treating doctor.
Great doctors, high-quality care. It's worth making an appointment in advance. The prices aren't the cheapest, but you have to pay for expertise.

The building complex can be reached from several streets. The easiest way to reach the auditorium is through the entrance on Bethlen Gábor Street. The corridors, courtyard and toilets are crowded, and many foreign students come here. Apart from the janitor, few people speak Hungarian, but he is willing and helpful. We listened to an exciting, interesting anatomy lecture on the body parts of horses. Professor Péter Sótonyi presented it on a live horse and drew the body parts. The farrier, who was part of the police force, was incredibly calm and cooperative. Anyone who saw it will never forget it.
I would like to ask for help. Does anyone know the appendix of the surgery? Otherwise, they won't let me call them.
Fajin's house
It works very well, dear, professionals.

My guinea pigs and I have been going to Dr. Dóra Csatári for years at the university. The doctor deserves a 5* both professionally and personally, she is very conscientious and kind. My pets are in the best hands with her, I have always left them there with peace of mind for examinations and surgeries. Sometimes there is a slight delay in the appointments, but often we get in line earlier.

Tequila came in at the beginning of April almost half dead, I haven't had the chance to thank the lady who took care of him for the very quick help! If she hadn't been my puppy, maybe he wouldn't be here today...!
He had two surgeries, both of which he endured like a little warrior!
I am very grateful to the staff there who helped Teki heal and recover!
Dr. Korinna Szabó, Dr. Réka Szögi Dr. Tünde Kanyorszky, Dr. Luca Rompos

The little lady at the reception was also very cute, we thank her for everything!! :)
Teki is doing well and will soon be celebrating his 3rd birthday, healthy and happy 😍

After we went there 4 hours later my little dog passed away😡😭💔💔💔🥹
I'll post the doctor's name later!!! …
We went to the Exotics department with a guinea pig, but we feel it is necessary to switch to another doctor since we are not progressing from five to six.

I visited this university to explore the campus environment as my daughter is preparing for admission next year. I politely approached the guardhouse to ask a security guard if it was possible to look inside.
However, one guard, without asking any questions, immediately tried to chase me away with an angry expression and even threatened me with a water bottle. To clarify the misunderstanding, I approached again and photographed the Hungarian notice posted there, wondering if I had done something wrong. The notice actually stated that visitors should inquire with the security guard for entry.
At that moment, another security guard came out, scowling and acting in a very high-handed manner. I then showed him my purpose for visiting, which I had translated into Hungarian. Only then did he explain that the school was on vacation and entry was not possible, and he apologized.
It seems urgent that the security personnel at this institution receive proper training on how to treat visitors. This was a deeply unpleasant experience at this school.

(Hungarian)

I visited this university to look around the campus environment, as my daughter wants to enroll here next year. I politely approached the guardhouse to ask the security guard if it was possible to look around.
However, one of the guards, without asking anything, immediately tried to distract me with an angry face and even threatened me with a water bottle. To clear up the misunderstanding, I stepped back and took a picture of the Hungarian information sheet posted, wondering if I had made a mistake. The information sheet actually said that you had to ask the security guard for entry.
At that moment, another security guard came out, with a sullen face and a very condescending manner. At that moment, I showed him the purpose of my visit, which I had translated into Hungarian. Only then did he explain that the school was on vacation and that entry was not allowed, and then apologized.
There is an urgent need for the institution's security staff to receive proper training on how to handle visitors. This was an extremely unpleasant experience at this university.
Small but beautiful campus and veterinary hospital.
Forgettable

We had an ultrasound with our puppy, examined by Dr. Márton Boros. A female assistant held our dog. Very nice team, both for the animal and the owners! We were able to be inside during the examination! Since they don't sedate me, I could pet and talk to my dog ​​all the time! I can only recommend it to everyone!

Female students here should be prepared for sexual harassment from Professor Dr. Attila Magyar. Collective complaints simply disappear, and the behavior is covered up. Everything from suggestive comments to physical assaults has occurred. His authority is shamelessly abused during exams when young women are alone in the room with him.

☆☆☆☆
Disappointment, undertreatment and disrespect – an undignified experience at the University of Veterinary Medicine

Unfortunately, I had an extremely unpleasant experience at the veterinary clinic at the University of Veterinary Medicine. From the very first minutes, the arrogant, condescending tone that accompanied our stay was noticeable. The staff’s style was downright offensive – not only towards me, but also towards my dog, who was openly criticized for “not meeting the breed standard”. This is not only a professional but also a completely unacceptable attitude as a human being.

The communication was incomplete, impatient and downright hostile. Not for a moment did I feel that they were addressing us with genuine interest, empathy or respect. Throughout the entire visit, I had the feeling that the staff was more concerned with asserting their own professional superiority than trying to help.

To top it all off, the price of the service was quite high – which in itself would not be a problem if we had received quality care, respectful treatment and a fair attitude in return. Unfortunately, none of this was achieved.

I was sincerely disappointed and deeply saddened that such a prestigious institution treats its clients in such an unworthy manner. I will certainly not recommend it to anyone, and I will certainly not return here.

I would like to ask the management of the institution to review the customer service practices of its employees, with particular attention to empathy, communication style and basic respect for owners and animals. I trust that such a prestigious and professionally important institution can learn from the criticism and create a more humane, open atmosphere in the future for those who trust them.
